- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 4, 5, 7) · ↓ invasive · Text-only score (-0.41 contribution) with 18/20 AI spot check [F3] · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 0) · context · Descriptive score (-0.33 contribution) with 8/20 AI spot check [F4] · Weak
- **Immune cells near tumor** (regions 2, 6, 7) · context · 92nd percentile proximity; 25–62 neoplastic-labeled nuclei per region [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful in dataset deletion tests (95% CI 0.002 to 0.020 excludes 0); all 12 regions here score 0.
- **Concepts**: Unproven in deletion tests (95% CI -0.009 to 0.006 includes 0); top driver normal lobules is unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Region 3 has elevated invasion concept score (1.15), distinguishing this slide from Normal contrast case BACH_0071 (89% similarity).
- Sampled regions 2, 6, and 7 contain true neoplasia (HoVer-Net segmented 25–62 neoplastic nuclei per region, 79th percentile density).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 3, 10**: Verify lobular architecture directly; normal lobules (0/20) and mitoses (0/20) concept scores are unreliable.
2. **Regions 2, 6, 7**: Inspect epithelium where HoVer-Net called 25–62 neoplastic nuclei with 92nd-percentile immune proximity.
3. **Regions 3, 4, 5, 7**: Confirm benign tubule formation (4, 5, 7) and exclude stromal invasion in region 3.
